name: Humbly Enough

descriptions.normal: A spiced tofu dish. Sautéed tofu is stir-fried with the sauce until browned and ready to serve. Despite the ordinary ingredients, the resulting dish is particularly mellow and fragrant, a perfect partner for rice. It can be said to be the home cook's dish of choice.
descriptions.suspicious: A spiced tofu dish. The tofu is far too spicy to enjoy as-is, but if you spend some time rinsing the excess seasoning off, you might be able to stomach it...
descriptions.delicious: A spiced tofu dish. The fried tofu comes with a rich soybean sauce as its classy chaperone. A single bite proves spicy with a hint of a meaty aroma, flooding your mouth with its mellow fragrance and long-lasting aftertaste.
